BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Promotions.Domain

ModuleMeta.Name: Promotions Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Promotions DDD domain: Promotions with eligibility rules and discount actions, CouponCodes with usage tracking, OrderPromotions linking applied promotions to orders, Calculators for discount computation, and Categories for organization.

Principle.name: Rule-Action Separation
Principle.Description: Promotions compose eligibility rules (cart total, product, category) with discount actions (percent, fixed, free shipping).
Principle.Rationale: Rules determine IF a promotion applies; actions determine WHAT happens.

Principle.name: Calculator Pattern
Principle.Description: Every action type has a corresponding calculator that computes the discount amount.
Principle.Rationale: Calculators are pure functions enabling testability and composition.

Principle.name: Activation Guard
Principle.Description: Promotions require at least one eligibility rule before activation.
Principle.Rationale: Prevents accidental activation of incomplete promotions.

Feature.name: Promotion Aggregate
Feature.Description: Promotion with rules, actions, activation state, and usage tracking.

Feature.name: Coupon Codes
Feature.Description: Cryptographic coupon codes with usage limits and expiry.

Feature.name: Discount Calculation
Feature.Description: Calculator pipeline computing promotion discounts on order totals.

Abstraction.name: Promotion
Abstraction.Description: Promotion aggregate with rules, actions, and activation state.

Abstraction.name: PromotionRule
Abstraction.Description: Eligibility rule (cart total threshold, product filter, category filter).
Abstraction.Purpose: Determine if a promotion applies to a given order.

Abstraction.name: PromotionAction
Abstraction.Description: Discount action (percent off, fixed amount, free shipping) with calculator binding.
Abstraction.Purpose: Define what discount to apply when rules match.

Abstraction.name: CouponCode
Abstraction.Description: Discount coupon code with usage limits, validity dates, and promotion linkage.

AntiPattern.name: Promotion Without Rules
AntiPattern.Avoid: Activating promotions with no eligibility rules.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Require at least one rule before activation; validate on Activate().
